text: Julqarnayni wi'i: "Ngoo heedo ko Yurmeende immornde ka Joomi am nde no heeda hakkunde Yaajuuja e Maajuuja e bonnugol ka leydi, ngo haɗa ɓe e ɗum, si waqtu mo Alla happi on fii yaltugol maɓɓe ado dargol Darngal ngal arii O wattinay ngo feppondirngo e leydi ndin, Fodoore Alla nden fii feppindirgol ngo e leydi ndin e yaltugol Yaajuuja e Maajuuja laatike ko tabituɗum lurral alaa e mu'un".
